newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - JAN 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - JAN 7.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

A woman has been killed on the London Underground, prompting new passenger safety fears. The elderly woman slipped between the platform and onto the track. The death will rekindle the call for guards recently withdrawn to save money.
GAS SET FOR GLOBAL PROFIT TURN AROUND

British Gas's exploration and production business will move into profit this year for the first time since privatisation. The market has been helped by the cold weather and a more general increase in demand.

A 500 million dollar loan arranged by Natwest Markets for Russian diamond producer Almazy-Rossii-Sakha has collapsed. The move followed De Beer's decision to terminate their diamond marketing agreement with Russia.
The plunge in Japanese shares could overshadow trading in London today. The collapse was sparked by fresh worries over the Japanese economy.
